remoteIntakeReview.rule: A changed upstream Alembic file is unreviewed evidence. The intake tool must not add revisions, rewrite translations, select a head, merge, or cherry-pick.

verified.scope: default runtime, migration unit coverage, and delete concurrency policy
live Template V2 upgrade, downgrade, re-upgrade, preservation, constraints, and deletion integrity

unsupported.reason: No documented version, service, or CI contract exists, and the unchanged baseline migration cannot compile unbounded String columns for MySQL (VARCHAR requires a length). URL adapters and defensive dialect branches remain compatibility scaffolding, not a support promise.

translations.note: Presentation versions remain separate locally; the initial Template V2 schema is consolidated into the guarded Phase 1 migration.
Frozen slide UI state is part of the guarded local Template V2 schema.
merged_components is created by the local Phase 1 migration.
The local baseline already creates presentations.fonts.
The local Template V2 product flow does not persist the upstream chat-scope foreign key.
Nullable layout/component payloads are created in their final form by Phase 1.
The upstream font_uploads persistence table is outside the local Template V2 compatibility surface.
Template and presentation identifiers are created in their final local types.
is_default is created by Phase 1 with its final default and nullability.
The local runtime retains async_presentation_generation_tasks rather than introducing upstream async_tasks.
Status normalization targets the upstream-only async_tasks table.

localOnlyExtensions.purpose: Private Template V2 local revision sidecar
localOnlyExtensions.legacyColumnDropGuard: Do not drop template_v2.presentation_id until the dropping migration validates complete, non-orphaned sidecars and verifies that the explicit child-first presentations-to-template_v2 delete path remains authoritative without this foreign key. The sidecar presentation FK only deletes the sidecar child; SQL cascades do not run child-to-parent.

localOnlyExtensions.foreignKeyPolicy: RESTRICT on both canonical and local-state presentation ownership foreign keys
localOnlyExtensions.compatibilityGuard: Validate complete, matching sidecar ownership before replacing both presentation ownership CASCADE actions with RESTRICT. Delete canonical templates explicitly in the presentation transaction and preserve import audit rows.
localOnlyExtensions.conflictPolicy: Return 409 presentation_delete_dependency_conflict when ownership diverges or a concurrent dependency survives.
localOnlyExtensions.sqliteConcurrencyPolicy: After rollback, return retryable 503 presentation_delete_temporarily_unavailable with Retry-After: 1 only for SQLite BUSY/LOCKED. Do not reclassify other database OperationalError values or multiply SQLite's bounded driver wait with an application retry loop.

localOnlyExtensions.purpose: Owner-scoped, idempotent PPTX analysis review and explicit confirmation boundary
